name: @aspire-bloods/shared
//sideEffects: Every module here is pure: type declarations, token objects, pure functions and zod schemas. Nothing registers a listener, patches a global or writes to a module-level singleton. Without this, Rollup has to assume `export * from './schemas/auth.js'` in the barrel might matter and keeps it — which put the whole of zod (53 kB) into the web app's ENTRY chunk, on a path that never validates anything, because the only thing importing it was the barrel itself.
